Done! I've implemented all three functions:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with B, KB, MB, GB units and one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — converts to lowercase, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-word characters except dashes
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches from `/api/users`, parses JSON, logs the user count using the project logger, and returns the array

All are exported from their modules.
